Rename app

Current app name:

3–64 characters. This is the app's display name, and the URL won't change. Opens a PR that editsdapp.json; the rename applies once the PR is voted in and merged.

Propose closing issue#?

This opens a group vote. If it passes, the issue is closed here and on GitHub.

Posted publicly on the GitHub issue when the vote passes.

Make your own version of this app

It’s yours to change. It starts as Just you.

Copied: the code, the look and the icon.

Starts fresh: it’s Just you, with an empty database. Invite people or open it up later.

Not copied: anyone’s data, keys, chat or members. If the app needs a key, you’ll add your own before it goes live.

Import a pull request

Pick an open pull request to add to In progress. It stays there until you ask for approval.

A staging preview is built from the pull request's head commit, so it takes a few minutes to appear, and automated checks stay pending until it does. Rows marked from a fork are branches in someone else's repository: review the changes on GitHub before importing.
